newsitem.title: USA: Lufthansa names Reid president and COO.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa names Reid president and COO.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG said Tuesday it had named Frederick Reid president and chief operating officer in conjunction with a plan to create a six-member executive management board.
The board will oversee all aspects of the airline's operations, revenue and profit, the company said.

Lufthansa said Reid, who joined the company five years ago as senior vice president for its Americas passenger division, was appointed executive vice president of the entire passenger division in December 1995.
The company said he is the first American to be named president of a non-U.S. airline.
